verdict.rationale: Hightouch ships a built-in agent, so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents Hightouch's own MCP server, which exposes Hightouch tools to outside AI assistants. That is the server role and does not show Hightouch consuming third-party MCP servers. No evidence shows its agent can connect to user-supplied MCP servers.
